task_context:
Code quality review of a focused change. Repo: /home/jpoimboe/imp.
DESCRIPTION: Task 8 — add `_emit_anthropic_web_events` + helpers (`_collect_text_citations`, `_normalize_web_result`) to anthropic.py and call the walker in _run_loop after append_llm_response. Emits normalized web tool_call/tool_result events with citations. Audit-only side path (never dispatches).
Assess:
- Correctness: the list-vs-dict content discrimination; the nested `_cite` closure merging text-block citations; empty-result handling; document-order emission; resilience to missing keys (`.get` usage).
- Clarity: function decomposition (3 small functions), naming, docstrings.
- Cohesion / single responsibility: each helper does one thing; testable independently.
- Tests verify real behavior; edge cases (url-only fetch) covered. Any gaps worth noting (e.g. multiple searches in one turn, missing-url results)?
- Anything unnecessary or over-engineered.
Return: Strengths; Issues tagged (Critical/Important/Minor); Assessment (APPROVED or CHANGES REQUESTED). If clean, APPROVED.

expected_findings.description: web_fetch body text extraction is broken against real API responses; code looks for doc.get('text') but SDK model_dump serializes to source.data, causing body text to be silently dropped from audit_text
Function stores title field in collected dict but _cite() never reads it from the citations dict; the stored title is dead weight
last-write-wins silently drops cited_text for duplicate URLs; when same URL appears in multiple text citations, only the last excerpt is kept, which is undocumented
No test coverage for error-content results; both web_search_tool_result_error and web_fetch_tool_result_error cases are not tested to verify they emit empty citations without raising
No test for multiple searches in one turn; a second server_tool_use+web_search_tool_result pair would exercise the multi-call ordering guarantee but is not tested
